final_text:
Mycobacterium is not supported. The report has only a few reads assigned to it, below the 10-read minimum for a species call.

The Mycobacterium clade has 6 reads in total. The species-level (rank S) counts are:

| Species | Clade reads |
|---|---|
| *Mycobacterium spongiae* | 3 |
| *Mycobacterium canetti* (under the *M. tuberculosis* complex) | 3 |

The largest single-species count is 3, so no species reaches 10. At this level these reads are consistent with background noise in a human-only sample.

RESULT: {"verdict": "not_supported", "max_species_reads": 3}
